summary: A modal confirm-or-cancel question before an action (delete, submit, reject). It only asks: the caller performs the action on confirmed. Controlled by the open input.

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Shows the dialog as a native modal <dialog>; the caller sets it back to false after confirmed or cancelled.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: The explanation under the title (translated); describes the dialog.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: danger: warning icon, destructive confirm button, and Cancel focused first.

inputs.name: busy
inputs.description: The action is running: Confirm shows a spinner and neither the buttons nor Escape emit.

outputs.name: cancelled
outputs.description: The cancel button or Escape was pressed.

slots.description: Extra body content under the message (a list, a reason field).

a11y: Native modal <dialog> with role=alertdialog and aria-modal, named by the title and described by the message; the page behind is inert. Focus moves to Confirm on open (Cancel for danger), Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside, Escape cancels, and focus returns to the opener on close. Logical CSS, mirrors in RTL.
